issues.explanation: Here 桓 abbreviates Emperor Huan (桓帝), not the surname “Huan.”
干政 is a lexicalized word meaning “to meddle in government”; splitting it hides a useful term.
issues.suggested_fix: Segment 干政 as one word: “to meddle in politics/government.”

issues.explanation: In 结党, 结 means “to form/join,” not “to produce” as a plant; 结党 is a natural lexical unit meaning “form a clique.”
issues.suggested_fix: Segment 结党 as one word: “to form a clique.”

issues.explanation: In this context 党 means “clique/faction,” not the surname Dang.
